description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. The controller manages salary-related views and data provisioning for employee salary information, utilizing services for pay grade info, and preparing Vue.js components with necessary data and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryController
classes.description: Controller class managing employee salary view. Extends BaseViewEmployeeController and utilizes traits for dependency injection and internationalization. Provides pay grade data to the view, configures Vue.js component properties, and enforces permissions.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the service for handling pay grade data, retrieved from the dependency container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering. Retrieves employee number from request, fetches currency, pay grade, and pay frequency data, sets component properties, and handles permissions. If employee number is missing, triggers bad request handling.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups likely used for capability or permission verification, specifically 'salary_details' in this context.
